sentences.text: Rannikko-Pohjanmaan Autohuolto Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-09-16 under the industry code 95312, other repair and maintenance of motor vehicles.
A start-up notification and a board change were both registered on 2026-09-25.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the name has a coastal place word but the registered industry is vehicle repair.
